messages:
Sam H: Heads-up — we have a planned change window for the runtime kernel update tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need a short statuspage blurb + customer email template. Can someone draft?
Priya M: I can start a statuspage draft. Will keep it short, list affected services and mitigation.
Jenna (support): Also need segmented customer language: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. Dedicated customers get pinned-notes + opt-out instructions.
Marcus R: For Dedicated: recommend we pin customers to current minor until after post-upgrade verification. If any Dedicated customer requests freeze, we should offer a backout window.
Alex (releases): Rollout plan: canary first 10% in region, 30m observation, then ramp. If latency regresses >15% or error rate >0.5% for 5m, automatic canary hold.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: kernel-update-v2 -> target: runtime-cluster-* -> window: 1919904321 (02:00 UTC) to 191990... Completed staging smoke tests.
Sam H: Good. Jenna, can you draft both a statuspage entry and an email template (short + long) we can send to customers? Include rollback conditions and estimated impact.
Jenna (support): Yep. Draft below — please review and call out any legal/compliance lines.
Jenna (support): STATUSPAGE DRAFT:
```
Scheduled maintenance: Runtime kernel update
Start: 2026-07-14 02:00 UTC
End (est): 2026-07-14 04:00 UTC
Impact: Brief elevated token latencies for <5% of requests during rollouts; no data plane downtime expected for hosted customers. Dedicated customers may see degraded throughput during node restarts; we will coordinate pinned windows on request.
What we're doing: Applying kernel update to improve throughput and security fixes.
Mitigation: Canary-first rollout, automatic rollback on regressions, support on standby.
```
Priya M: Suggest add a one-line customer-facing impact summary at top: "Minor latency increases possible; no expected downtime for hosted APIs."
Marcus R: Add "If you require a maintenance freeze, contact support@redwood.ai by EOD today." for Dedicated/Private customers.
Legal Bot: Please avoid promises like "no downtime" — use "no expected downtime" and include contact link for SLA questions.
Jenna (support): Updated. EMAIL TEMPLATE (SHORT):
```
Subject: Planned maintenance — runtime update (2026-07-14)
Hi {{customer_name}},
We will perform a planned runtime kernel update on 2026-07-14 from 02:00–04:00 UTC. You may see brief increases in latency; no data loss is expected. If you have Dedicated or Private deployments and need to opt out, reply to this email or open a ticket by EOD today.
Thanks,
Redwood Inference Support
```
Alex (releases): Add a line for SDK users: "If you pin model variants or have long-lived KV caches, consider clearing caches after the maintenance."
Jenna (support): EMAIL TEMPLATE (LONG — for high-usage customers):
```
Subject: Planned maintenance & potential impact — runtime kernel update (2026-07-14)
Hi {{customer_name}},
What: Kernel upgrade to runtime nodes to improve throughput and apply security fixes.
When: 2026-07-14 02:00–04:00 UTC (est.)
Potential impact:
  - Hosted: brief latency spikes for up to 5% of requests during rolling restarts.
  - Dedicated: reduced throughput during node restarts; we recommend pinning or scheduling an alternative window.
  - Private: if air-gapped, coordinate with your infra contact.
Mitigation: Canary-first rollout, 30m observation windows, automatic rollback triggers (latency + error thresholds). Support & SRE will monitor and can initiate emergency rollbacks.
Action required: If you need a maintenance freeze or want us to schedule outside this window, contact support@redwood.ai with your account id by EOD today.
Questions: reply to this thread or open a ticket.
Regards,
Redwood Inference Support & Releases
```
Priya M: LGTM. Also add statuspage incident tag: "maintenance" and short link to postmortem if anything unexpected happens.
Sam H: Good. Marcus — please confirm Dedicated pinning wording and rollback policy one more time so support can publish.
Marcus R: Confirmed: we will pin Dedicated clusters to the pre-update runtime image for +24h post-rollout by default. If rollback required, we will revert within the same change window where possible; otherwise we'll coordinate a scheduled rollback.
Jenna (support): OK I'll publish these to statuspage and queue the customer email batch for EOD. Will drop the final links here once published. @statusbot can you post the statuspage URL when live?
statusbot: Statuspage update published: https://status.redwood.ai/maintenance/kernel-update-2026-07-14 (visible to public).
Jenna (support): Email batch queued. Template used: "long" for accounts with >1M tokens/mo, otherwise "short".
Sam H: Thanks all. Keep this thread updated if metrics or rollback triggers fire during the window. :thumbsup:
